symbols.name: cpu_work
symbols.doc: CPU-bound arithmetic — the profiler's favourite patient.

symbols.name: cpu_burn_mixed
symbols.doc:
Calls cpu_work in rounds and mixes in small sleeps — so a CPU profile
    shows both burning time (cpu_work) and waiting (time.sleep), not just one.

symbols.name: quick_task
symbols.doc:
One small unit of work for the pipeline (sleeps a beat so the
    concurrency timeline shows overlapping threads).

symbols.name: pipeline
symbols.doc:
Run `tasks` units across `workers` threads and record every span.

    Returns a list of {thread, task, start_ms, end_ms} measured with
    time.monotonic() — the raw material of the concurrency timeline chart.

symbols.name: allocate_blocks
symbols.doc:
Allocate `blocks` chunks of `size` bytes while tracemalloc watches —
    the memory profile's raw material (top sites + totals).

symbols.name: racing_counter
symbols.doc:
A REAL data race: threads do read-modify-write on one integer with no
    lock. CPython's GIL makes each single bytecode atomic, but the three-step
    read-add-write is not — updates get lost whenever a thread switch lands
    between the read and the write.

    widen=False: the natural window. On CPython 3.12 the switch check lands
    on the loop backedge, so short runs may lose nothing — that

symbols.doc: Group faulthandler dump frames per thread header.

findings.message: 'authorize' is named like an authorization check, has no verification call, prints/logs only, and returns success on every path
findings.remediation: Call a real verification primitive (credential lookup, permission check) and propagate its result

findings.message: result of authorization call 'authorize' (line 4) is bound to 'ok' but never branched on before a sensitive operation ('cursor.execute' @ 5, 'cursor.execute' @ 6)
findings.remediation: Check the authorization result and abort the sensitive operation on rejection

findings.message: UI/API-layer function 'ui.delete_account' touches the database directly (effects: ["db_write", "print"]); data access should live behind a data/repository module

findings.message: bare except in 'refund' (line 20) has no re-raise — swallowed error has no recovery path
findings.remediation: Catch typed errors and re-raise or convert; never swallow bare

findings.message: bare except in 'collect_deadlock' (line 184) has no re-raise — swallowed error has no recovery path
findings.remediation: Catch typed errors and re-raise or convert; never swallow bare

findings.message: possible hardcoded secret in string literal (line 15)
findings.remediation: Move the secret to a secret manager / environment variable

findings.message: tainted input (user_id) reaches SQL execute sink 'cursor.execute' at line 5; no sanitizer observed on this path
findings.remediation: Use parameterized queries / safe APIs; validate and encode the input

findings.message: query call 'cursor.fetchall' inside a loop body (line 12) — N+1 pattern
findings.remediation: Batch the query outside the loop or use a bulk API
